q1_issues.issue: (Patient sk_lose_1 dow_jones_industrial_average) puts the transitive SUBJECT of 'having lost 74.81' in the object role - a transitive subject is Agent even when inanimate, and Patient here reads as the average itself being lost.
'In the first hour' is rendered with During, but the oblique rule states that During renders only the word 'during' and 'in' stays In - a near-fit synonym head is explicitly barred.
'the first hour OF trading' is likewise rendered with During, again substituting a synonym head for the surface preposition.

The name symbol and Name string swallow the lowercase common nouns 'industrial average'; by the casing rule the name is exactly the capitalized run ('Dow Jones'), with the adjacent lowercase kind stated in a separate type atom.
(Member ... index) asserts a kind no word in the text supplies - the text's own kind word is 'average', so 'index' is unlicensed world knowledge.
The unit 'point' is not in the text (the figure is bare '27.02'); the same invented unit recurs on statements 13 and 18.
The scale 'level' is coined for the bare apposed figure '9,321.84' - no dimension adjective or dimension noun is stated anywhere in the clause.

q2_gaps: appositive / equative 'or' ('down 27.02, or 0.3 percent') - a restatement of the same quantity in other units, not a disjunction; Disjunction treats every 'or' as inclusive disjunction and has no restatement sense
bare index-point magnitudes with no unit word ('down 27.02', 'lost 74.81'): Measure requires a unit, forcing either an invented unit or dropping the figure
a percentage as a MEASURE of change ('or 0.3 percent'): percentages are covered only as (Fraction p 100) inside a partitive ProportionOf, not as a magnitude on a Measure
elliptical apposition of a resulting level ('..., 0.3 percent, 9,321.84,' - the 'to/at' is missing in the source): no dimension word is stated, so the Measure scale has to be invented

'the first hour of trading' - an ordinal-selected sub-interval of an activity: Ordinal is defined for entity ranks on an event or '-est' scale, and the of-phrase is neither genitive, partitive nor a 'during' nesting
notes: The copular-with-time-modifier dual-emit (reified sk_down_1 state with Experiencer plus the flat (Past (Member ... down))) and the perfect-participle anteriority (Before sk_lose_1 sk_down_1) are both correct. Source text is elliptical around '9,321.84', which licenses a best-effort reading but not the coined scale/unit symbols.
